【个体设定】
| 条目 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 参与者编号：P4。 |
| 2 | 本次角色：填写自己若被抽为Y类时使用的条件贡献表。 |
| 3 | 本情境资源：10点。 |

【实验规则】
- 四名参与者P1、P2、P3、P4匿名组成一组，每人有10点，其中没有投入共同项目的点数归本人保留。
- 本情境中有三名X类参与者和一名Y类参与者。计算机随机确定谁是Y类，每个人被选中的机会相同。你填写的是自己若被选为Y类时使用的条件贡献表。
- 计算机分别从0至10的整数中为P1、P2、P3抽取贡献点数。每个数被抽中的概率相同，三次抽取相互独立；三人的实际贡献由这些抽取值决定。
- 条件表上方的数值，是P1、P2、P3实际贡献点数的算术平均数取最近整数所得。
- 条件表列出0至10的整数。填写时尚不知道实际会对应哪一列；若你被选为Y类，就以实际对应那一列中填写的数作为你的贡献。此处只要求填写其中一格，其余格不在本次作答范围内。
- 每人的收益＝10－本人实际贡献＋0.75×全组四人的实际贡献总和。每人保留的点数只归本人，共同项目的收益由四人按相同规则分别获得。
- 你可填写0至10中的任意整数作为贡献点数。你不知道其他三人的逐人贡献，不能由取整后的表头数值断定逐人贡献或准确总和。

【当前情况】
现在只填写条件表表头为3的那一格。这个表头值是假设条件，不表示你已看到实际发生的贡献或实际抽取结果。

【独立事实检查】
下面哪一项符合本题当前条件？只判断事实，不作社会行为选择。
A：本组三名X类参与者的实际贡献由计算机独立均匀抽取0至10的整数决定。
B：本组三名X类参与者的实际贡献由其本人此刻自主决定。
只输出JSON对象，仅包含answer字段，值为A或B。
Please answer the factual question based on the provided material, outputting only the required JSON object.

Individual setup
| Item | Content |
|---|---|
| 1 | Participant identifier: P4. |
| 2 | Your role this time: complete the conditional contribution table to be used if you are selected as type Y. |
| 3 | Resources in this situation: 10 points. |

Experimental rules
- Four participants, P1, P2, P3, and P4, anonymously form a group. Each has 10 points, and any points not contributed to the joint project are retained by that participant.
- In this situation there are three type-X participants and one type-Y participant. The computer randomly determines who is type Y, with everyone having the same chance of being selected. You are completing the conditional contribution table that will be used if you are selected as type Y.
- The computer draws a contribution for each of P1, P2, and P3 from the integers 0 to 10. Every number has the same probability of being drawn, and the three draws are independent; these drawn values determine the three participants' actual contributions.
- The values above the conditional table are the arithmetic mean of the actual contributions of P1, P2, and P3, rounded to the nearest integer.
- The conditional table lists integers from 0 to 10. When completing it, you do not yet know which column will actually apply; if you are selected as type Y, the value you entered in the applicable column will be your contribution. Here you are only asked to complete one cell; the other cells are outside the scope of this answer.
- Each participant's payoff＝10－their own actual contribution＋0.75×the total actual contributions of all four group members. The points each participant retains belong only to that participant, while all four receive the returns from the joint project separately according to the same rule.
- You may enter any integer from 0 to 10 as your contribution. You do not know the individual contributions of the other three participants, and the rounded column heading does not allow you to determine their individual contributions or the exact total.

Current situation
Now complete only the cell with column heading 3 in the conditional table. This heading is a hypothetical condition; it does not mean that you have observed the contributions that actually occurred or the actual random draw.

Independent factual check
Which of the following statements matches the current conditions in this question? Judge only the facts; do not make a social behavior choice.
A: The actual contributions of the three type-X participants in this group are determined by the computer independently drawing integers uniformly from 0 to 10.
B: The actual contributions of the three type-X participants in this group are freely chosen by those participants themselves at this moment.
Output only a JSON object containing only the answer field, whose value is A or B.

【个体设定】

【实验规则】
| 条目 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 1 | 本题是匿名的一次分配决策。 |

| 3 | P2只能接收分配，没有拒绝权。你可以不惩罚，也可以花费自己的1点进行惩罚；惩罚会使每位提议者保留的收益减少30%，再将其剩余收益取最近整数。扣除的点数不转给你或P2。 |
| 4 | 不惩罚时，P3保留5点，P1、P4、P5各得9点，P2得1点；惩罚时，P3保留4点，P1、P4、P5各自保留的9点均减少30%并取最近整数，分别变为6点，P2仍得1点。 |

【当前情况】
P1、P4、P5共同执行的平均提议是给P2 1点。三名提议者因此各保留9点，P2得到1点。题目仅给出共同执行的平均提议，没有逐人列出三名成员原先的提议。

【独立事实检查】
下面哪一项符合本题当前条件？只判断事实，不作社会行为选择。
A：实施惩罚时，你自己需要支付1点。
B：实施惩罚时，你自己需要支付3点。
只输出JSON对象，仅包含answer字段，值为A或B。

Individual setup
- Participant identifier: P3.
- Your role this time: a third-party decision-maker who is neither a proposer nor the recipient.
- You have 5 points and may freely decide whether to spend 1 point on punishment.

Experimental rules
| Item | Content |
|---|---|
| 1 | This question is a one-time anonymous allocation decision. |
| 2 | P1, P4, and P5 are three proposers, each proposing an allocation based on 10 points. The arithmetic mean of the amounts that the three individually propose to give the recipient becomes the jointly implemented proposal. Each proposer's retained payoff is calculated using this common proposal; a single remaining payoff is not divided among the three. |
| 3 | P2 can only receive the allocation and has no right to reject it. You may choose not to punish, or spend 1 point of your own to punish; punishment reduces each proposer's retained payoff by 30%, after which their remaining payoff is rounded to the nearest integer. The deducted points are not transferred to you or P2. |
| 4 | Without punishment, P3 retains 5 points, P1, P4, and P5 each receive 9 points, and P2 receives 1 points; with punishment, P3 retains 4 points, the 9 points retained by each of P1, P4, and P5 are reduced by 30% and rounded to the nearest integer, becoming 6 points each, while P2 still receives 1 points. |

Current situation
The average proposal jointly implemented by P1, P4, and P5 is to give P2 1 points. The three proposers therefore each retain 9 points, and P2 receives 1 points. The question only provides the jointly implemented average proposal and does not list the three members' original proposals individually.

Independent factual check
Which of the following statements matches the current conditions in this question? Judge only the facts; do not make a social behavior choice.
A: When carrying out punishment, you must pay 1 point yourself.
B: When carrying out punishment, you must pay 3 points yourself.
Output only a JSON object containing only the answer field, whose value is A or B.

A: The program forcibly transferred the initial 4000 points from P1; P1 had no choice.
B: P1 freely decided to send the initial 4000 points.
Output only a JSON object containing only the answer field, whose value is A or B.
